decision_protocol.purpose: Prospective selection and final evaluation after the legacy multi-budget test results were inspected.

budget_provenance.reason: No dated ex-ante business constraint or analysis record is present in this project snapshot.

data_contract.final_evaluation_requirement: uniform sample from source rows excluded from the development sample

policy_roles.rejection_scope: promotion against response at the legacy 20 percent operating point

selection.objective: maximize incremental net value versus target nobody

champion_challenger.promotion_budget: response budget selected on validation under the primary economic scenario
champion_challenger.promotion_rule: promote only if the paired 95 percent lower confidence bound for challenger minus champion incremental net value is greater than zero and the Hajek sensitivity estimate has the same direction
champion_challenger.online_requirement: offline promotion qualifies a challenger for a prospective randomized online test; it does not authorize automatic deployment

result_card.headline: Validation selected response at 2% under the explicitly hypothetical primary economic scenario. On the fresh disjoint final sample, its incremental net value versus target nobody was 4825.4 hypothetical_currency_units; retain_champion_superiority_not_demonstrated.
